source_snapshot.procedure: Match recipe; clear logs; change all/random IIO settings; save/reboot and confirm retention; Load Defaults/save/reboot and confirm SPEC; collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: No errors or reboot failure; changed setting persists; default matches SPEC.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; requires manual BIOS/KVM but omits lane, bifurcation, endpoint and AER effects.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; required a safe IIO matrix, complete PCIe route oracle, link/enumeration/AER evidence, preserved logs and physical recovery.

old_problem: The historical record awaited IIO defaults, safe routing/bifurcation values, a full PCIe topology oracle and recovery because Master requests all/random modification and log clearing.
disposition_reason: The approved BIOS rule establishes reversible one-setting-at-a-time execution and prohibits all/random changes. For IIO, a route-aware value or coherent bifurcation group plus complete project PCIe topology/link/error oracle provides a safe test. Board-specific routes and recovery remain runtime configuration, not unresolved review semantics.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2181, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2182 / Wistron-BIOS-00499-V003 / 3d37a9f57d8c06a8 was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Reject all/random; approve one reversible IIO route control or coherent bifurcation dependency group.
Bind BIOS/CPU/socket plus every root port, switch, retimer, lane route and endpoint stable identity.
Compare BDF, endpoint identity, generation/width, affinity, driver and AER for affected and sibling paths after each phase.
Drain affected workloads; operator controls KVM save/reboot/Load-Defaults while automation collects read-only PCIe evidence.
Preserve AER/SEL/kernel logs; prohibit retrain/reset and sign boot limits plus KVM/physical/CMOS recovery.
No BIOS/IIO setting, log, PCIe state, reboot, Load Defaults, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Controlled IIO persistence, PCIe-route integrity and default-restoration validation
test_case.purpose: Verify each approved reversible IIO routing/bifurcation value persists and restores to Project SPEC while every expected PCIe path and sibling retains correct endpoint, generation, width, affinity, driver and error state.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator and drained maintenance window
BIOS/CPU/socket and full PCIe route identity
Project-default and route-aware reversible IIO matrix
test_case.test_command: Operator captures baseline IIO page and full PCIe topology, changes one approved reversible control or coherent bifurcation group, saves/reboots, validates every affected and sibling root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint path, re-enters BIOS to prove retention, then performs approved Load Defaults and repeats page/topology/link/error comparisons. Stop at the first anomaly.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved IIO value persists; all expected endpoints remain on signed routes with correct BDF identity, generation/width, affinity and drivers and no prohibited AER; after Load Defaults the page and full PCIe topology equal Project SPEC.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only for the approved matrix when screenshots and all signed per-path criteria match. Missing/moved endpoint, wrong route, downgrade, driver loss, surprise removal or disallowed AER is FAIL. Missing runtime topology/value/recovery oracle is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until route/lane ownership, values/dependencies, workload drain, criteria and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or an IIO value incompatible with board wiring/endpoints.
Preserve AER/SEL/kernel evidence; no reset, retrain, log clearing or automatic retry.
Operator controls save/reboot/Load-Defaults/recovery; stop on boot or management-path loss.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and BIOS/CPU/socket/PCIe route identity
Baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults and restored screenshots
Per-phase root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint BDF, identity, gen/width, affinity and driver comparison
Preserved AER/SEL/kernel evidence plus sibling-path health
Restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on endpoint loss, route/link drift, AER or no-boot and preserve evidence. Qualified personnel restore last-known-good IIO through KVM or signed physical/CMOS recovery; do not retrain/reset endpoints, clear logs or blindly retry.

source_conflict.reason: Target and acceptance consistently cover IIO persistence/default restoration; unsafe all/random wording is constrained without reducing full-route coverage.

blocked.reason: Safe route-aware method is clear; exact board topology, values and recovery are runtime inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BIOS/CPU/socket/PCIe topology, Project SPEC defaults, reversible routing/bifurcation values, per-path link/driver/AER criteria, workload drain and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED MANUAL TEST; RUNTIME PROJECT CONFIGURATION AND EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION REQUIRED; NO BIOS, PCIE, LOG, REBOOT, DEFAULT, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: BIOS/PCIe platform owner and qualified KVM/physical operator
pending.unlock_condition: Populate and sign route-specific values, complete topology oracle and recovery before execution; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.

external_authorities.authority: User-approved ED-11 BIOS safety principle and ED-01 through ED-30
external_authorities.application: Uses approved one-setting-at-a-time execution while preserving complete IIO route and sibling-path evidence.

project_authority: BIOS/PCIe owner signs routing, defaults, per-path criteria and recovery; operator performs manual workflow; end engineer owns verdict.
